source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4.4 (PDF 217), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Kamyab karobar samajhte hain ke un ke customers ko kya chahiye, aur aise products dete hain jo woh zarooratein poori karein.

Misal: Karachi mein water purifier (pani saaf karne wali machine) bechne wala karobar saaf peene ke pani ki zaroorat par zor de sakta hai, khaas taur par garmiyon ke mahinon mein jab pani ka maiyar (quality) ek masla ban sakta hai.

Misal: Lahore ka ek chhota start-up (naya karobar) haath se bane zevrat online bechta hai. Customers ko lane ke liye woh Instagram aur Facebook jaise social media platforms par apne products dikhata hai. Woh maqami influencers ke saath bhi kaam karta hai ta ke zyada logon tak pohanche. Shadiyon ke mausam mein thore waqt ke liye discount de kar woh apni sales barhata hai. In strategies se start-up apni market tak achhi tarah pohanchta hai aur karobar barhata hai.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Pakistan mein e-commerce (online khareed o farokht) ka shoba tezi se barh raha hai, aur pehle se kahin zyada log online khareedari kar rahe hain. Jo karobar apne products ki online achhi marketing karte hain woh kahin zyada logon tak pohanch sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Karachi ka water purifier bechne wala karobar garmiyon mein kis zaroorat par zor deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Saaf peene ke pani ki zaroorat par, kyunke garmiyon mein pani ka maiyar (quality) masla ban sakta hai. Yani karobar customer ki asal zaroorat pehchan kar usi ko apni marketing ka markaz banata hai (kitab ki misal).

items: Customer ki zaroorat samjhein aur usi ke mutabiq product aur offer dein (water purifier, online zevrat start-up).
